subject.title: fix(agents): bound pdf tool maxBytesMb model parameter

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a 100 MB ceiling for model-supplied PDF tool requests while retaining the existing operator-configured PDF limit behavior?
rationale: The patch introduces a user-visible model-tool input policy and its relationship to operator-controlled limits needs an explicit owner decision rather than inference from a related unmerged PR.

options.title: Approve the 100 MB model ceiling
options.body: Keep the model-input cap, preserve operator-configured fallback behavior, and require real runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Choose a different contract
options.body: Set another cap or expose a documented policy only after defining how models and operator PDF limits should interact.

recommendation.title: Approve the 100 MB model ceiling
recommendation.body: Keep the model-input cap, preserve operator-configured fallback behavior, and require real runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main feature ownership could not be established from the available read-only evidence.
